ayahs.textArabic: تَنْزِيْلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْحَكِيْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Tanzīlul-kitābi minallāhil-‘azīzil-ḥakīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: THE BESTOWAL from on high of this divine writ issues from God, the Almighty, the Wise:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَنْزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللّٰهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā anzalnā ilaikal-kitāba bil-ḥaqqi fa‘budillāha mukhliṣal lahud-dīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, behold, it is We who have bestowed this revela­tion upon thee from on high, setting forth the truth: so worship Him, sincere in thy faith in Him alone!

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَا لِلّٰهِ الدِّيْنُ الْخَالِصُ ۗوَالَّذِيْنَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اَوْلِيَاۤءَۘ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ اِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُوْنَآ اِلَى اللّٰهِ زُلْفٰىۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِيْ مَا هُمْ فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ ەۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهْدِيْ مَنْ هُوَ كٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Alā lillāhid-dīnul-khāliṣ(u), wal-lażīnattakhażū min dūnihī auliyā'(a), mā na‘buduhum illā liyuqarribūnā ilallāhi zulfā, innallāha yaḥkumu bainahum fī mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūn(a), innallāha lā yahdī man huwa kāżibun kaffār(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Is it not to God alone that all sincere faith is due? And yet, they who take for their protectors aught beside Him [are wont to say], “We worship them for no other reason than that they bring us nearer to God.” Behold, God will judge between them [on Resur­rection Day] with regard to all wherein they differ [from the truth]: for, verily, God does not grace with His guidance anyone who is bent on lying [to himself and is] stubbornly ingrate!

ayahs.textArabic: لَوْ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ اَنْ يَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّاصْطَفٰى مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاۤءُ ۙ سُبْحٰنَهٗ ۗهُوَ اللّٰهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau arādallāhu ay yattakhiża waladal laṣṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yasyā'(u), subḥānah(ū), huwallāhul-wāḥidul-qahhār(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Had God willed to take Unto Himself a son, He could have chosen anyone that He wanted out of whatever He has created - [but] limitless is He in His glory! He is the One God, the One who holds absolute sway over all that exists!

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّۚ يُكَوِّرُ الَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى الَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَۗ كُلٌّ يَّجْرِيْ لِاَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىۗ  اَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْغَفَّارُ
ayahs.textLatin: Khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqq(i), yukawwirul-laila ‘alan-nahāri wa yukawwirun nahāra ‘alal-laili wa sakhkharasy-syamsa wal-qamar(a), kulluy yajrī li'ajalim musammā(n), alā huwal-‘azīzul-gaffār(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: He it is who has created the heavens and the earth in accordance with [an inner] truth. He causes the night to flow into the day, and causes the day to flow into the night; and He has made the sun and the moon subservient [to His laws], each running its course for a term set [by Him]. Is not He the Almighty, the All-Forgiving?

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ نَّفْسٍ وَّاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَاَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَنْعَامِ ثَمٰنِيَةَ اَزْوَاجٍ ۗ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِيْ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِيْ ظُلُمٰتٍ ثَلٰثٍۗ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُۗ  لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚ فَاَنّٰى تُصْرَفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Khalaqakum min nafsiw wāḥidatin ṡumma ja‘ala minhā zaujahā wa anzala lakum minal-an‘āmi ṡamāniyata azwāj(in), yakhluqukum fī buṭūni ummahātikum khalqam mim ba‘di khalqin fī ẓulumātin ṡalāṡ(in), żālikumullāhu rabbukum lahul-mulk(u), lā ilāha illā huw(a), fa'annā tuṣrafūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: He has created you [all] out of one living entity, and out of it fashioned its mate; and he has be­stowed upon you four kinds of cattle of either sex; [and] He creates you in your mothers’ wombs, one act of creation after another, in threefold depths of darkness. Thus is God, your Sustainer: unto Him belongs all dominion: there is no deity save Him: how, then, can you lose sight of the truth?

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ تَكْفُرُوْا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكُمْ ۗوَلَا يَرْضٰى لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَۚ وَاِنْ تَشْكُرُوْا يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزْرَ اُخْرٰىۗ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَۗ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌ ۢبِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.textLatin: In takfurū fa'innallāha ganiyyun ‘ankum, wa lā yarḍā li‘ibādihil-kufr(a), wa in tasykurū yarḍahu lakum, wa lā taziru wāziratuw wizra ukhrā, ṡumma ilā rabbikum marji‘ukum fa yunabbi'ukum bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a), innahū ‘alīmum biżātiṣ-ṣudūr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: If you are ingrate behold, God has no need of you; none the less, He does not approve of in­gratitude in His servants: whereas, if you show grati­tude, He approves it in you. And no bearer of burdens shall be made to bear another’s burden. In time, unto your Sustainer you all must return, and then He will make you [truly] understand all that you were doing [in life]: for, verily, He has full knowledge of what is in the hearts [of men].

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَاِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهٗ مُنِيْبًا اِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلَهٗ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوْٓا اِلَيْهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلّٰهِ اَنْدَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيْلِهٖ ۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيْلًا ۖاِنَّكَ مِنْ اَصْحٰبِ النَّارِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā massal-insāna ḍurrun da‘ā rabbahū munīban ilaihi ṡumma iżā khawwalahū ni‘matan minhu nasiya mā kāna yad‘ū ilaihi min qablu wa ja‘ala lilllāhi andādal liyuḍilla ‘an sabīlih(ī), qul tamatta‘ bikufrika qalīlā(n), innaka min aṣḥābin-nār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW [thus it is:] when affliction befalls man, he is likely to cry out to his Sustainer, turning unto Him [for help]; but as soon as He has bestowed upon him a boon by His grace, he forgets Him whom he in­voked before, and claims that there are other powers that could rival God - and thus leads [others] astray from His path. Say [unto him who sins in this way]: “Enjoy thyself for a while in this thy denial of the truth; [yet,] verily, thou art of those who are destined for the fire!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ اٰنَاۤءَ الَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَّقَاۤىِٕمًا يَّحْذَرُ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوْا رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهٖۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى الَّذِيْنَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۗ اِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Amman huwa qānitun ānā'al-laili sājidaw wa qā'imay yaḥżarul-ākhirata wa yarjū raḥmata rabbih(ī), qul hal yastawil-lażīna ya‘lamūna wal-lażīna lā ya‘lamūn(a), innamā yatażakkaru ulul-albāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or [dost thou deem thyself equal to] one who devoutly worships [God] throughout the night, prostrating himself or standing [in prayer], ever- mindful of the life to come, and hoping for his Sustainer’s grace?” Say: “Can they who know and they who do not know be deemed equal?” [But] only they who are endowed with insight keep this in mind!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ يٰعِبَادِ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوْا رَبَّكُمْ ۗلِلَّذِيْنَ اَحْسَنُوْا فِيْ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ  ۗوَاَرْضُ اللّٰهِ وَاسِعَةٌ  ۗاِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصّٰبِرُوْنَ اَجْرَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul yā ‘ibādil-lażīna āmanuttaqū rabbakum, lil-lażīna aḥsanū fī hāżihid-dun-yā ḥasanah(tun), wa arḍullāhi wāsi‘ah(tun), innamā yuwaffaṣ-ṣābirūna ajrahum bigairi ḥisāb(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “[Thus speaks God:] ‘O you servants of Mine who have attained to faith! Be conscious of your Sustainer! Ultimate good awaits those who per­severe in doing good in this world. And [remember:] wide is God’s earth, [and,] verily, they who are patient in adversity will be given their reward in full, beyond all reckoning!’”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنِّيْٓ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ اللّٰهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul innī umirtu an a‘budallāha mukhliṣal lahud-dīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say [O Muhammad]: “Behold, I am bidden to worship God, sincere in my faith in Him alone;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاُمِرْتُ لِاَنْ اَكُوْنَ اَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa umirtu li'an akūna awwalal-muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and I am bidden to be foremost among those who surrender themselves unto God.”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ اِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّيْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul innī akhāfu in ‘aṣaitu rabbī ‘ażāba yaumin ‘aẓīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “Behold, I would dread, were I to rebel against my Sustainer, the suffering [which would befall me] on that awesome Day [of Judgment].”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلِ اللّٰهَ اَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهٗ دِيْنِيْۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Qulillāha a‘budu mukhliṣal lahū dīnī.
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “God alone do I worship, sincere in my faith in Him alone -

ayahs.textArabic: فَاعْبُدُوْا مَا شِئْتُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖۗ قُلْ اِنَّ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ الَّذِيْنَ خَسِرُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَاَهْلِيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِۗ  اَلَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِيْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa‘budū mā syi'tum min dūnih(ī), qul innal-khāsirīnal-lażīna khasirū anfusahum wa ahlīhim yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), alā żālika huwal-khusrānul-mubīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [it is up to you, O sinners, to] worship whatever you please instead of Him!” Say: “Behold, the [true] losers will be they who shall have lost their own selves and their kith and kin on Resurrection Day: for is not this, this, the [most] obvious loss?

ayahs.textArabic: لَهُمْ مِّنْ فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ  ۗذٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللّٰهُ بِهٖ عِبَادَهٗ ۗيٰعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Lahum min fauqihim ẓulalum minan-nāri wa min taḥtihim ẓulal(un), żālika yukhawwifullāhu bihī ‘ibādah(ū), yā ‘ibādi fattaqūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Clouds of fire will they have above them, and [similar] clouds beneath them…” In this way does God imbue His servants with fear. O you servants of Mine! Be, then, conscious of Me -

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوْتَ اَنْ يَّعْبُدُوْهَا وَاَنَابُوْٓا اِلَى اللّٰهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرٰىۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażīnajtanabuṭ-ṭāgūta ay ya‘budūhā wa anābū ilallāhi lahumul-busyrā, fabasysyir ‘ibād(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: seeing that for those who shun the powers of evil lest they [be tempted to] worship them, and turn unto God instead, there is the glad tiding [of happiness in the life to come]. Give, then, this glad tiding to [those of] My ser­vants

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ يَسْتَمِعُوْنَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُوْنَ اَحْسَنَهٗ ۗ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ هَدٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمْ اُولُوا الْاَلْبَابِ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna yastami‘ūnal-qaula fa yattabi‘ūna aḥsanah(ū), ulā'ikal-lażīna hadāhumullāhu wa ulā'ika hum ulul-albāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: who listen [closely] to all that is said, and follow the best of it: [for] it is they whom God has graced with His guidance, and it is they who are [truly] endowed with insight!

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِۗ اَفَاَنْتَ تُنْقِذُ مَنْ فِى النَّارِ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Afaman ḥaqqa ‘alaihi kalimatul-‘ażāb(i), afa'anta tunqiżu man fin-nār(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: On the other hand, could one on whom [God’s] sentence of suffering has been passed [be rescued by man]? Couldst thou, perchance, save one who is [already, as it were,] in the fire?

ayahs.textArabic: لٰكِنِ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّنْ فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ  ۙتَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ ەۗ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ ۗ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللّٰهُ الْمِيْعَادَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lākinil-lażīnattaqau rabbahum lahum gurafum min fauqihā gurafum mabniyyah(tun), tajrī min taḥtihal-anhār(u), wa‘dallāh(i), lā yukhlifullāhul-mī‘ād(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As against this they who of their Sustainer are conscious shall [in the life to come] have man­sions raised upon mansions high, beneath which run­ning waters flow: [this is] God’s promise - [and] never does God fail to fulfill His promise.

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءً فَسَلَكَهٗ يَنَابِيْعَ فِى الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهٖ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا اَلْوَانُهٗ ثُمَّ يَهِيْجُ فَتَرٰىهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهٗ حُطَامًا ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰى لِاُولِى الْاَلْبَابِ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam tara annallāha anzala minas-samā'i mā'an fasalakahū yanābī‘a fil-arḍi ṡumma yaj‘aluhū ḥuṭāmā(n), ina fī żālika lażikrā li'ulil-albāb(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: ART THOU NOT aware that it is God who sends down water from the skies, and then causes it to travel through the earth in the shape of springs? And then He brings forth thereby herbage of various hues; and then it withers, and thou canst see it turn yellow; and in the end He causes it to crumble to dust. Verily, in [all] this there is indeed a reminder to those who are endowed with insight!

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَمَنْ شَرَحَ اللّٰهُ صَدْرَهٗ لِلْاِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلٰى نُوْرٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ ۗفَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقٰسِيَةِ قُلُوْبُهُمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ ۗ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Afaman syaraḥallāhu ṣadrahū lil-islāmi fahuwa ‘alā nūrim mir rabbih(ī), fawailul lil-qāsiyati qulūbuhum min żikrillāh(i), ulā'ika fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Could, then, one whose bosom God has opened wide with willingness towards self-surrender unto Him, so that he is illumined by a light [that flows] from his Sustainer, [be likened to the blind and deaf of heart]? Woe, then, unto those whose hearts are hardened against all remembrance of God! They are most obviously lost in error!

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ نَزَّلَ اَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيْثِ كِتٰبًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَۙ  تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُوْدُ الَّذِيْنَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ۚ ثُمَّ تَلِيْنُ جُلُوْدُهُمْ وَقُلُوْبُهُمْ اِلٰى ذِكْرِ اللّٰهِ ۗذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللّٰهِ يَهْدِيْ بِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ ۗوَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ هَادٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhu nazzala aḥsanal-ḥadīṡi kitābam mutasyābiham maṡāniy(a), taqsya‘irru minhu julūdul-lażīna yakhsyauna rabbahum, ṡumma talīnu julūduhum wa qulūbuhum ilā żikrillāh(i), żālika hudallāhi yahdī bihī may yasyā'(u), wa may yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū min hād(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: God bestows from on high the best of all teachings in the shape of a divine writ fully consistent within itself, repeating each statement [of the truth] in manifold forms [a divine writ] whereat shiver the skins of all who of their Sustainer stand in awe: [but] in the end their skins and their hearts do soften at the remembrance of [the grace of] God. Such is God’s guidance: He guides therewith him that wills [to be guided] whereas he whom God lets go astray can never find any guide

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَمَنْ يَّتَّقِيْ بِوَجْهِهٖ سُوْۤءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ ۗوَقِيْلَ لِلظّٰلِمِيْنَ ذُوْقُوْا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Afamay yattaqī biwajhihī sū'al-‘ażābi yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), wa qīla liẓ-ẓālimīna żūqū mā kuntum taksibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Could, then, one who shall have nothing but is [bare] face to protect him from the awful suffering [that will befall him] on Resurrection Day [be likened to the God-conscious]? [On that Day,] the evildoers will be told: “Taste [now] what you have earned [in life]!”

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَاَتٰىهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Każżabal-lażīna min qablihim fa'atāhumul-‘ażābu mi ḥaiṡu lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Those who lived before them did [too] give the lie to the truth - whereupon suffering befell them without their having perceived whence it came:

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَذَاقَهُمُ اللّٰهُ الْخِزْيَ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚوَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَكْبَرُ ۘ لَوْ كَانُوْا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa ażāqahumullāhul-khizya fil-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wa la‘ażābul-ākhirati akbar(u), lau kānū ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and thus God let them taste ignominy [even] in the life of this world. Yet [how] much greater will be the [sinners’] suffering in the life to come - if they [who now deny the truth] but knew it!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِيْ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ḍarabnā lin-nāsi fī hāżal-qur'āni min kulli maṡalil la‘allahum yatażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: THUS, INDEED, have We propounded unto men all kinds of parables in this Qur’an, so that they might bethink themselves; [and We have revealed it]

ayahs.textArabic: قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِيْ عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qur'ānan ‘arabiyyan gaira żī ‘iwajil la‘allahum yattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: as a discourse in the Arabic tongue, free of all devious­ness, so that they might become conscious of God.

ayahs.textArabic: ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيْهِ شُرَكَاۤءُ مُتَشٰكِسُوْنَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيٰنِ مَثَلًا ۗ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ ۗبَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḍaraballāhu maṡalar rajulan fīhi syurakā'u mutasyākisūna wa rajulan salamal lirajulin hal yastawiyāni maṡalā(n), al-ḥamdu lillāh(i), bal akṡaruhum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [To this end,] God sets forth a parable: A man who has for his masters several partners, [all of them] at variance with one another, and a man depending wholly on one person: can these two be deemed equal as regards their condition? [Nay,] all praise is due to God [alone]: but most of them do not understand this.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَّاِنَّهُمْ مَّيِّتُوْنَ ۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innaka mayyituw wa innahum mayyitūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet, verily, thou art bound to die, [O Muhammad,] and, verily, they, too, are bound to die:

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُوْنَ ࣖ   ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma innakum yaumal-qiyāmati ‘inda rabbikum takhtaṣimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and then, behold, on the Day of Resurrection you all shall place your dispute before your Sustainer.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ فَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ اِذْ جَاۤءَهٗۗ  اَلَيْسَ فِيْ جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Faman aẓlamu mimman każaba ‘alallāhi wa każżaba biṣ-ṣidqi iż jā'ah(ū), alaisa fī jahannama maṡwal lil-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And who could be more wicked than he who invents lies about God? and gives the lie to the truth as soon as it has been placed before him? Is not hell the [proper] abode for all who deny the truth?

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْ جَاۤءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهٖٓ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażī jā'a biṣ-ṣidqi wa ṣaddaqa bihī ulā'ika humul-muttaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But he who brings the truth, and he who wholeheartedly accepts it as true - it is they, they, who are [truly] conscious of Him!

ayahs.textArabic: لَهُمْ مَّا يَشَاۤءُوْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ ذٰلِكَ جَزَاۤءُ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Lahum mā yasyā'ūna ‘inda rabbihim, żālika jazā'ul-muḥsinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: All that they have ever yearned for awaits them with their Sustainer: such will be the reward of the doers of good.

ayahs.textArabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمْ اَسْوَاَ الَّذِيْ عَمِلُوْا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ اَجْرَهُمْ بِاَحْسَنِ الَّذِيْ كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyukaffirallāhu ‘anhum aswa'al-lażī ‘amilū wa yajziyahum ajrahum bi'aḥsanil-lażī kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And to this end, God will efface from their record the worst that they ever did, and give them their reward in accordance with the best that they were doing [in life].

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهٗۗ وَيُخَوِّفُوْنَكَ بِالَّذِيْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۗ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ هَادٍۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Alaisallāhu bikāfin ‘abdah(ū), wa yukhawwifūnaka bil-lażīna min dūnih(ī), wa may yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū min hād(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: IS NOT God enough for His servant? And yet, they would frighten thee with those [imaginary divine powers which they worship] beside Him! But he whom God lets go astray can never find any guide,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنْ يَّهْدِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ مُّضِلٍّ ۗ اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِعَزِيْزٍ ذِى انْتِقَامٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa may yahdillāhu famā lahū min muḍill(in), alaisallāhu bi‘azīzin żintiqām(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: whereas he whom God guides aright can never be led astray. Is not God almighty, an avenger of evil?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَىِٕنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ اللّٰهُ ۗ قُلْ اَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَّا تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اِنْ اَرَادَنِيَ اللّٰهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كٰشِفٰتُ ضُرِّهٖٓ اَوْ اَرَادَنِيْ بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكٰتُ رَحْمَتِهٖۗ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ ۗعَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa la'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunnallāh(u), qul afara'aitum mā tad‘ūna min dūnillāhi in arādaniyallāhu biḍurrin hal hunna kāsyifātu ḍurrihī au arādanī biraḥmatin hal hunna mumsikātu raḥmatih(ī), qul ḥasbiyallāh(u), ‘alaihi yatawakkalul-mutawakkilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And thus it is [with most people]: if thou ask them, “Who is it that has created the heavens and the earth?” - they will surely answer, “God.” Say: “Have you, then, ever considered what it is that you invoke instead of God? If God wills that harm should befall me, could those [imaginary powers] remove the harm inflicted by Him? Or, if He wills that grace should alight on me, could they withhold His grace [from me]?” Say: “God is enough for me! In Him [alone] place their trust all who have trust [in His existence].”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ يٰقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّيْ عَامِلٌ ۚفَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul yā qaumi‘malū ‘alā makānatikum innī ‘āmil(un), fa saufa ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “O my [truth-denying] people! Do yet all that may be within your power, [whereas] I, behold, shall labour [in God’s way]: in time you will come to know

ayahs.textArabic: مَنْ يَّأْتِيْهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخْزِيْهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: May ya'tīhi ‘ażābuy yukhzīhi wa yaḥillu ‘alaihi ‘ażābum muqīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: who it is that shall be visited [in this world] by suffering which will cover him with ignominy, and upon whom long-lasting suffering shall alight [in the life to come]!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّۚ فَمَنِ اهْتَدٰى فَلِنَفْسِهٖۚ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَاِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۚوَمَآ اَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيْلٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā anzalnā ‘alaikal-kitāba lin-nāsi bil-ḥaqq(i), fa manihtadā fa linafsih(ī), wa man ḍalla fa innamā yaḍillu ‘alaihā, wa mā anta ‘alaihim biwakīl(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD, from on high have We bestowed upon thee this divine writ, setting forth the truth for [the benefit of all] mankind. And whoever chooses to be guided [thereby], does so for his own good, and whoever chooses to go astray, goes but astray to his own hurt; and thou hast not the power to determine their fate.

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْاَنْفُسَ حِيْنَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِيْ لَمْ تَمُتْ فِيْ مَنَامِهَا ۚ فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِيْ قَضٰى عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْاُخْرٰىٓ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhu yatawaffal-anfusa ḥīna mautihā wal-latī lam tamut fī manāmihā, fayumsikul-latī qaḍā ‘alaihal-mauta wa yursilul-ukhrā ilā ajalim musammā(n), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yatafakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: It is God [alone that has this power - He] who causes all human beings to die at the time of their [bodily] death, and [causes to be as dead], during their sleep, those that have not yet died: thus, He withholds [from life] those upon whom He has decreed death, and lets the others go free for a term set [by Him]. In [all] this, behold, there are messages indeed for people who think!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ شُفَعَاۤءَۗ قُلْ اَوَلَوْ كَانُوْا لَا يَمْلِكُوْنَ شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا يَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Amittakhażū min dūnillāhi syufa‘ā'(a), qul awalau kānū lā yamlikūna syai'aw wa lā ya‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet, they choose [to worship], side by side with God, [imaginary] intercessors!” Say: “Why - even though they have no power over anything, and no understanding?”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ لِّلّٰهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيْعًا ۗ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۗ ثُمَّ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul lillāhisy-syafā‘atu jamī‘ā(n), lahū mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), ṡumma ilaihi turja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “God’s alone is [the power to bestow the right of] intercession: His [alone] is the dominion over the heavens and the earth; and, in the end, Unto Him you will all be brought back.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَـَٔزَّتْ قُلُوْبُ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِۚ وَاِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā żukirallāhu waḥdahusyma'azzat qulūbul-lażīna  lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirah(ti), wa iżā żukiral-lażīna min dūnihī iżā hum yastabsyirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet, whenever God alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who will not believe in the life to come contract with bitter aversion - whereas, when those [imaginary powers] are mentioned side by side with Him, lo, they rejoice!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ عٰلِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ اَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيْ مَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qulillāhumma fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍi ‘ālimal-gaibi wasy-syahādati anta taḥkumu baina  ‘ibādika fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “O God! Originator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of all that is beyond the reach of a created being’s perception, as well as of all that can be witnessed by a creature’s senses or mind! It is Thou who wilt judge between Thy servants [on Resurrection Day] with regard to all on which they were wont to differ!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ اَنَّ لِلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مَا فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيْعًا وَّمِثْلَهٗ مَعَهٗ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهٖ مِنْ سُوْۤءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِۗ وَبَدَا لَهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُوْنُوْا يَحْتَسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau anna lil-lażīna ẓalamū mā fil-arḍi jamī‘aw wa miṡlahū ma‘ahū laftadau bihī min sū'il-‘ażābi yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), wa badā lahum minallāhi mā lam yakūnū yaḥtasibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But if those who are bent on evildoing posses­sed all that is on earth, and twice as much, they would surely offer it as ransom from the awful suffering [that will befall them] on the Day of Resur­rection: for, something with which they had not reckoned before will [by then] have been made obvious to them by God;

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوْا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa badā lahum sayyi'ātu mā kasabū wa ḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and obvious to them will have become the evil that they had wrought [in life]: and thus shall they be overwhelmed by the very truth which they were wont to deride.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَاۖ  ثُمَّ اِذَا خَوَّلْنٰهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّاۙ قَالَ اِنَّمَآ اُوْتِيْتُهٗ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ ۗبَلْ هِيَ فِتْنَةٌ وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa'iżā massal-insāna ḍurrun da‘ānā ṡumma iżā khawwalnāhu ni‘matam minnā, qāla innamā ūtītuhū ‘alā ‘ilm(in), bal hiya fitnatuw wa lākinna akṡarahum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW [thus it is:] when affliction befalls man, he cries out unto Us for help; but when We bestow upon him a boon by Our grace, he says [to himself], “I have been given [all] this by virtue of [my own] wisdom!” Nay, this [bestowal of grace] is a trial: but most of them understand it not!

ayahs.textArabic: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qad qālahal-lażīna min qablihim famā agnā ‘anhum mā kānū yaksibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: The same did say [to themselves many of] those who lived before their time; but of no avail to them was all that they had ever achieved:

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوْا ۗوَالَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مِنْ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ سَيُصِيْبُهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا كَسَبُوْا ۙوَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa'aṣābahum sayyi'ātu mā kasabū, wal-lażīna ẓalamū min hā'ulā'i sayuṣībuhum  sayyi'ātu mā kasabū, wa mā hum bimu‘jizīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for all the evil deeds that they had wrought fell [back] upon them. And [the same will happen to] people of the present time who are bent on wrongdoing: all the evil deeds that they have ever wrought will fall [back] upon them, and never will they be able to elude [God]!

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam ya‘lamū annallāha yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yasyā'u wa yaqdir(u), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Are they, then, not aware that it is God who grants abundant sustenance, or gives it in scant measure, unto whomever He wills? In this, behold, there are messages indeed for peo­ple who will believe!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓى اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۗاِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul yā ‘ibādiyal-lażīna asrafū ‘alā anfusihim lā taqnaṭū mir raḥmatillāh(i), innallāha yagfiruż-żunūba jamī‘ā(n), innahū huwal-gafūrur-raḥīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY: “[Thus speaks God:] ‘O you servants of Mine who have transgressed against your own selves! Despair not of God’s mercy: behold, God forgives all sins - for, verily, He alone is much-forgiving, a dis­penser of grace!’”

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَنِيْبُوْٓا اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ وَاَسْلِمُوْا لَهٗ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa anībū ilā rabbikum wa aslimū lahū min qabli ay ya'tiyakumul-‘ażābu ṡumma lā tunṣarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, turn towards your Sustainer [alone] and surrender yourselves unto Him ere the suffering [of death and resurrection] comes upon you, for then you will not be succoured.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاتَّبِعُوْٓا اَحْسَنَ مَآ اُنْزِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَّاَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wattabi‘ū aḥsana mā unzila ilaikum mir rabbikum min qabli ay ya'tiyakumul ‘ażābu bagtataw wa antum lā tasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And ere that suffering comes upon you of a sudden, without your being aware [of its approach], follow the most goodly [teaching] that has been revealed unto you by your Sustainer,

ayahs.textArabic: اَنْ تَقُوْلَ نَفْسٌ يّٰحَسْرَتٰى عَلٰى مَا فَرَّطْتُّ فِيْ جَنْۢبِ اللّٰهِ وَاِنْ كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السّٰخِرِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: An taqūla yā ḥasratā ‘alā mā farraṭṭu fī jambillāhi wa in kuntu laminas-sākhirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: lest any human being should say [on Judgment Day], “Alas for me for having been remiss in what is due to God, and for having been indeed one of those who scoffed [at the truth]!”

ayahs.textArabic: اَوْ تَقُوْلَ لَوْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ هَدٰىنِيْ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Au taqūla lau annallāha hadānī lakuntu minal-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: or lest he should say, “If God had but guided me, I would surely have been among those who are conscious of Him!”-

ayahs.textArabic: اَوْ تَقُوْلَ حِيْنَ تَرَى الْعَذَابَ لَوْ اَنَّ لِيْ كَرَّةً فَاَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Au taqūla ḥīna taral-‘ażāba lau anna lī karratan fa akūna minal-muḥsinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: or lest he should say, when he becomes aware of the suffering [that awaits him], “Would that I had a second chance [in life], so that I could be among the doers of good!”

ayahs.textArabic: بَلٰى قَدْ جَاۤءَتْكَ اٰيٰتِيْ فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Balā qad jā'atka āyātī fa każżabta bihā wastakbarta wa kunta minal-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But God will reply:] “Yea, indeed! My mes­sages did come unto thee; but thou gavest them the lie, and wert filled with false pride, and wert among those who deny the truth!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ تَرَى الَّذِيْنَ كَذَبُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ وُجُوْهُهُمْ مُّسْوَدَّةٌ  ۗ اَلَيْسَ فِيْ جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaumal-qiyāmati taral-lażīna każabū ‘alallāhi wujūhuhum muswaddah(tun), alaisa fī jahannama maṡwal lil-mutakabbirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [so,] on the Day of Resurrection thou wilt see all who invented lies about God [with] their faces darkened [by grief and ignominy]. Is not hell the [proper] abode for all who are given to false pride?

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُنَجِّى اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْۖ  لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوْۤءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yunajjillāhul-lażīnattaqau bimafāzatihim, lā yamassuhumus-sū'u wa lā hum yaḥzanūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But God will safeguard all who were conscious of Him, [and will grant them happiness] by virtue of their [inner] triumphs; no evil shall ever touch them, and neither shall they grieve.

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ ۙوَّهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّكِيْلٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhu khāliqu kulli syai'(in), wa huwa ‘alā kulli syai'iw wakīl(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: GOD is the Creator of all things, and He alone has the power to determine the fate of all things.

ayahs.textArabic: لَهٗ مَقَالِيْدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۗ وَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Lahū maqālīdus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wal-lażīna kafarū bi'āyātillāhi ulā'ika humul-khāsirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: His are the keys [to the mysteries] of the heavens and the earth: and they who are bent on denying the truth of God’s messages - it is they, they, who are the losers!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اَفَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ تَأْمُرُوْۤنِّيْٓ اَعْبُدُ اَيُّهَا الْجٰهِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul afagairallāhi ta'murūnnī a‘budu ayyuhal-jāhilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “Is it, then, something other than God that you bid me to worship, O you who are unaware [of right and wrong]?”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اُوْحِيَ اِلَيْكَ وَاِلَى الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَۚ  لَىِٕنْ اَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ūḥiya ilaika wa ilal-lażīna min qablik(a), la'in asyrakta layaḥbaṭanna ‘amaluka wa latakūnanna minal-khāsirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet, it has already been revealed to thee [O man,] as well as to those who lived before thee, that if thou ever ascribe divine powers to aught but God, all thy works shall most certainly have been in vain: for [in the life to come] thou shalt most certainly be among the lost.

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ اللّٰهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُنْ مِّنَ الشّٰكِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Balillāha fa‘bud wa kum minasy-syākirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay, but thou shalt worship God [alone], and be among those who are grateful [to Him]!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهٖۖ وَالْاَرْضُ جَمِيْعًا قَبْضَتُهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وَالسَّمٰوٰتُ مَطْوِيّٰتٌۢ بِيَمِيْنِهٖ ۗسُبْحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā qadarullāha ḥaqqa qadrih(ī), wal-arḍu jamī‘an qabḍatuhū yaumal-qiyāmati was-samāwātu maṭwiyyātum biyamīnih(ī), subḥānahū wa ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And no true understanding of God have they [who worship aught beside Him], inasmuch as the whole of the earth will be as a [mere] handful to Him on Resurrection Day, and the heavens will be rolled up in His right hand: limitless is He in His glory, and sublimely exalted above anything to which they may ascribe a share in His divinity!

ayahs.textArabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصُّوْرِ فَصَعِقَ مَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنْ فِى الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا مَنْ شَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ ۗ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيْهِ اُخْرٰى فَاِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَّنْظُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nufikha fiṣ-ṣūri faṣa‘iqa man fis-samāwāti wa man fil-arḍi illā man syā'allāh(u), ṡumma nufikha fīhi ukhrā fa'iżā hum qiyāmuy yanẓurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [on that Day,] the trumpet [of judgment] will be sounded, and all [creatures] that are in the heavens and all that are on earth will fall down senseless, unless they be such as God wills [to exempt]. And then it will sound again - and lo! standing [before the Seat of Judgment], they will begin to see [the truth]!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَشْرَقَتِ الْاَرْضُ بِنُوْرِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتٰبُ وَجِايْۤءَ بِالنَّبِيّٖنَ وَالشُّهَدَاۤءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa asyraqatil-arḍu binūri rabbihā wa wuḍi‘al-kitābu wa jī'a bin-nabiyyīna wasy-syuhadā'i wa quḍiya bainahum bil-ḥaqqi wa hum lā yuẓlamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the earth will shine bright with her Sus­tainer’s light. And the record [of everyone’s deeds] will be laid bare, and all the prophets will be brought forward, and all [other] witnesses; and judgment will be passed on them all in justice. And they will not be wronged,

ayahs.textArabic: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa wuffiyat kullu nafsim mā ‘amilat wa huwa a‘lamu bimā yaf‘alūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for every human being will be repaid in full for whatever [good or evil] he has done: and He is fully aware of all that they do.

ayahs.textArabic: وَسِيْقَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِلٰى جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۗحَتّٰىٓ اِذَا جَاۤءُوْهَا فُتِحَتْ اَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ اَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنْكُمْ يَتْلُوْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنْذِرُوْنَكُمْ لِقَاۤءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا ۗقَالُوْا بَلٰى وَلٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wasīqal-lażīna kafarū ilā jahannama zumarā(n), ḥattā iżā jā'ūhā futiḥat abwābuhā wa qāla lahum khazanatuhā alam ya'tikum rusulum minkum yatlūna ‘alaikum āyāti rabbikum wa yunżirūnakum liqā'a yaumikum hāżā, qālū balā wa lākin ḥaqqat kalimatul-‘ażābi ‘alal-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And those who were bent on denying the truth will be urged on in throngs towards hell till, when they reach it, its gates will be opened, and its keepers will ask them, “Have there not come to you apostles from among yourselves, who conveyed to you your Sustainer’s messages and warned you of the coming of this your Day [of Judgment]?” They will answer: “Yea, indeed!” But the sentence of suffering will [already] have fallen due upon the deniers of the truth;

ayahs.textArabic: قِيْلَ ادْخُلُوْٓا اَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا ۚفَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qīladkhulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā, fa bi'sa maṡwal-mutakabūbirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] they will be told, “Enter the gates of hell, therein to abide!” And how vile an abode for those who were given to false pride!

ayahs.textArabic: وَسِيْقَ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ اِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۗحَتّٰىٓ اِذَا جَاۤءُوْهَا وَفُتِحَتْ اَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوْهَا خٰلِدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wasīqal-lażīnattaqau rabbahum ilal-jannati zumarā(n), ḥattā iżā jā'ūhā wa futiḥat abwābuhā wa qāla lahum khazanatuhā salāmun ‘alaikum ṭibtum fadkhulūhā khālidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But those who were conscious of their Sus­tainer will be urged on in throngs towards paradise till, when they reach it, they shall find its gates wide- open; and its keepers will say unto them, “Peace be upon you! Well have you done: enter, then, this [paradise], herein to abide!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهٗ وَاَوْرَثَنَا الْاَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّاُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَاۤءُ ۚفَنِعْمَ اَجْرُ الْعٰمِلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālul-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī ṣadaqanā wa‘dahū wa auraṡanal-arḍa natabawwa'u minal-jannati ḥaiṡu nasyā'(u), fani‘ma ajrul-‘āmilīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they will exclaim: “All praise is due to God, who has made His promise to us come true, and has bestowed upon us this expanse [of bliss] as our portion, so that we may dwell in paradise as we please!” And how excellent a reward will it be for those who laboured [in God’s way]!

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَى الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةَ حَاۤفِّيْنَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُوْنَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْۚ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيْلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa taral-malā'ikata ḥāffīna min ḥaulil-‘arsyi yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim, wa quḍiya bainahum bil-ḥaqqi wa qīlal-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And thou wilt see the angels surrounding the throne of [God’s] almightiness, extolling their Sus­tainer’s glory and praise. And judgment will have been passed in justice on all [who had lived and died], and the word will be spoken: “All praise is due to God, the Sustainer of all the worlds!”
